# PrimaSTEM

> Screen-free coding and mathematics for children ages 4–10+. Wooden programmable robot with tangible NFC command tokens.

PrimaSTEM is a wooden educational robot made in Cannes, France. Children build a program from command tokens placed on a control board, and the robot runs it, no screen, no app required. The same coding goes further than typical screen-free robots: not just moving forward and a few set turns, but any distance, any angle, and real arithmetic, so the coding runs straight into real math. One robot covers ages 4 to 10+: logic for ages 4 to 7, mathematics for ages 7 to 10+, and Scratch keeps the same robot going past age ten. Insert a marker and the robot draws geometric figures (stars, spirals, polygons), making math visible. CE & UKCA certified.

## Key Facts

- Material: Wood (robot, board), cardboard (tokens)
- Age range: 4–10+ (Scratch keeps the same robot going past age ten)
- Certification: CE & UKCA
- Made in: Cannes, France
- No screen, no app, no subscription
- The robot runs (executes) the program the child builds; the child does the calculating
- Open NFC platform - tokens writable with free phone app
- Compatible with any grid map - step size adjustable to any value (for example 10 cm, 12.5 cm, 15 cm)
- Mathematics tokens: +, -, ×, ÷, √, ^
- Voice feedback in 18 languages, any language added on request - board speaks each token when placed, robot plays the sounds when the program runs, more than 90 words available
- Braille version in pilot testing
- Documentation in 10 languages
